info.name: Returns a list of appliance details based on filtering, ordering and paging criteria.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: The id of the customer in UUID format.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the appliance. All of the appliances that at least contain part of the passed parameter will be filtered.

params.name: is_online
params.description: Flag that indicates whether appliance is online. True means online.

params.name: total_mb_size_from
params.description: Minimum size of storage attached to the appliance in MB.

params.name: total_mb_size_to
params.description: Maximum size of storage attached to the appliance in MB.

params.name: total_mb_free_from
params.description: Minimum amount of free space on storage attached to the appliance in MB.

params.name: total_mb_free_to
params.description: Maximum amount of free space on storage attached to the appliance in MB.

params.name: version
params.description: The version of the appliance. All of the appliances that at least contain part of the passed parameter will be filtered.

params.name: helix_status
params.description: The status of helix for the appliances.

items.docs: Visibility is restricted by tenant which issued credentials for access.
